---
title: "summary.yml"
---

Post a Claude summary comment on newly opened issues.

The workflow runs [`claude-code-action`](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action)
authenticated with the `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` secret.
A read-only job writes the summary,
and a separate job with `issues: write` posts it.
If the secret is missing or the summary comes back empty,
the workflow emits a notice and leaves the issue unchanged
instead of failing the issue-open run.

## Inputs

| Input | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | Claude model identifier. Letters, digits, and `. _ : / -` only. When empty, the action's default model is used. | string | `""` | No |

## Secrets

| Secret | Description | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | OAuth token for `claude-code-action`. | No |

## Permissions

Grant `issues: write` and `contents: read`.

## Migrating from the `endpoint` input

The workflow no longer calls GitHub Models,
which is retiring ([gha#617](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/617),
[gha#1133](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1133)).
Delete `with: endpoint:` and the `API_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` secrets
from the caller,
drop `models: read` from its permissions,
and pass `secrets: inherit` so the job receives `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/summary.yml in your repo.
# Posts a Claude summary comment on each newly opened issue.
# Needs the CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN secret; without it the run is skipped with a notice.
# The calling job must grant issues:write + contents:read.
name: Summarize new issues

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  summary:
    permissions:
      issues: write
      contents: read
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/summary.yml@v3
    secrets: inherit
    # with:
    #   model: claude-haiku-5-5
```

See [`examples/summary.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/summary.yml)
for the full caller stub.
